title: Spawn Groups
description: A spawn groups definition for Minecraft Bedrock Edition. Spawn groups define collections of entities that spawn together under specific conditions, such as during raid events.

format_version.title: Format Version
format_version.description: The format version of this spawn groups file. Typically '1.11.0'.

minecraft:spawn_groups.title: Spawn Groups Definition
minecraft:spawn_groups.description:
The spawn groups definition container.

Properties:
• description ({ identifier })
• conditions

description.title: Description
description.description:
The spawn group description containing identifier information.

Properties:
• identifier (string)

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: The unique identifier for this spawn group (e.g., 'minecraft:raid_group_0').

defaultSnippets.label: Description
defaultSnippets.description: The spawn group description containing identifier information.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description:
Array of condition sets that determine when and how entities spawn.

Properties:
• minecraft:mob_event_filter ({ event })
• minecraft:distance_filter ({ min, max })
• minecraft:spawns_on_surface (object)
• minecraft:spawns_underground (object)
• minecraft:spawns_underwater (object)
• minecraft:difficulty_filter ({ min, max })
• minecraft:herd ({ min_size, max_size, event, ... })
• minecraft:permute_type

minecraft:mob_event_filter.title: Mob Event Filter
minecraft:mob_event_filter.description:
Filters based on mob events.

Properties:
• event (string)

event.title: Event
event.description: The mob event that triggers this spawn group (e.g., 'minecraft:village_raid').

minecraft:distance_filter.title: Distance Filter
minecraft:distance_filter.description:
Filters based on distance from a reference point.

Properties:
• min (int)
• max (int)

defaultSnippets.label: Distance Filter
defaultSnippets.description: Filters based on distance from a reference point.

minecraft:spawns_on_surface.title: Spawns On Surface
minecraft:spawns_on_surface.description: Indicates entities should spawn on surface blocks.

minecraft:difficulty_filter.title: Difficulty Filter
minecraft:difficulty_filter.description:
Filters based on game difficulty.

Properties:
• min (enum)
• max (enum)

minecraft:herd.title: Herd
minecraft:herd.description:
Defines the group size and spawn event for the herd.

Properties:
• min_size (int)
• max_size (int)
• event (string)
• event_skip_count (string)

min_size.title: Minimum Size
min_size.description: Minimum number of entities in the herd.

max_size.title: Maximum Size
max_size.description: Maximum number of entities in the herd.

event.title: Event
event.description: The event to trigger on spawned entities.

event_skip_count.title: Event Skip Count
event_skip_count.description: Number of entities to skip before triggering the event.

defaultSnippets.label: Herd
defaultSnippets.description: Defines the group size and spawn event for the herd.

minecraft:permute_type.title: Permute Type
minecraft:permute_type.description:
Defines weighted entity type options for spawning.

Properties:
• weight (int)
• entity_type (string)

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: The relative weight of this entity type.

entity_type.title: Entity Type
entity_type.description: The entity type identifier to spawn.
